highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds missing tvOS surface overloads and improves native binary hardening.
highlights_body: Android symbol packages are preserved for native debugging, while Windows native binaries gain additional compiler and control-flow protections.

bullets.detail: Adds the missing SKSurface.Create overloads for tvOS applications.
Android native symbols remain available for consumers diagnosing native failures.

contributor_summaries.Aguilex: Native binary hardening improvements for Windows
contributor_summaries.MartinZikmund: Completed the missing tvOS SKSurface.Create overloads

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 added the tvOS surface overloads and Android symbol packaging.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 added native binary hardening improvements.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Preview 3 completed release validation for the 3.119.2 line.

harfbuzz_summary: Includes the HarfBuzzSharp binding updates delivered with the 3.119.2 release line.
